blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free objectives, and action labels on only 5% of the pairs also fail to ground the channels. Given an action, predicted relational changes approach the quality of observed future relations (AUROC .599 vs .621). For one-step relational goals, a supervised readout of the 16 channels ranks the correct action among the top five of 65 in 43% of cases, compared with 24% for prediction-only latents and 17% for a frequency prior.
blocks.zh: 联合组合的预测性结构(JEPAs)在潜在的空间中学习世界模型,从而能够进行有效的规划,但使其状态不透明。 我们引入了内部-JEPA, 将订购的实体对在JEPA潜伏状态内的关系渠道, 并显示,当其头部单独或作为完整状态的一部分读取时, 反向动力学损失可以打碎这些通道而无关系标签。 在Something-Something V2上,仅潜伏的预测并不比随机关系头更好,而从通道变化中恢复动作的反动力学监督则通过下列方式改进了关系AUROC:在附加说明的10个设置中,0.65-103;在RH20T机器人事件上,0.81;在使用现成检测和跟踪的5个关系上,0.50-061。 实体潜伏物的反向头可以更准确地解码动作,但几乎无法改善关系定位;洗牌标签,两个无标签目标,只有5%的对子上的动作标签也未能打下通道. 鉴于一项行动,预测的关系变化将接近所观察到的未来关系的质量(AUROC 599 vs.621)。 就一步步的关系目标而言,16个渠道的监督读取将正确行动排在65个案例的前5位,占43%,而仅预测潜伏的占24%,先前频率的占17%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World models that predict in a learned latent space rather than in pixels can ignore what is unpredictable and keep what matters for acting [ 26 , 4 , 8 ] , and they now support planning from images and video [ 5 , 49 , 7 ] .
Their states, however, are opaque vectors.
A probe trained on relation labels can often read from them whether the cup is inside the bowl, but no part of the state is committed to that relation, so neither a goal nor what the model believes can be stated in those terms, although relations between objects are the natural vocabulary for both [ 46 , 21 , 47 ] .
In our real-video evaluations, these relations are geometric predicates computed from 2D entity bounding boxes, so inside denotes an image-plane proxy for containment.
blocks.zh:
世界模型在学习到的潜在空间中而不是在像素中预测,可以忽略什么是无法预测的,并保留什么是行动的关键[26、4、8],它们现在支持从图像和视频中进行规划[5、49、7]。
然而,它们的状态是不透明的载体。
接受过关系标签培训的探针往往可以从中读出杯子是否在碗内,但州内没有一部分人致力于这种关系,因此无论是目标还是模型认为的,都无法用这些词语来表述,尽管物体之间的关系是两者的自然词汇[46,21,47].
在我们的真视频评价中,这些关系是从2D实体边框中计算出来的几何上方,所以内部代表了用于封装的图像平面代用.

blocks.en:
A direct remedy is to build the relations into the state: for every ordered pair of entities, a small vector of soft symbols, which we call relational channels, that the predictor consumes and forecasts like the rest of the latent.
Unlike neuro-symbolic pipelines that read predicates out of a representation with supervised heads [ 24 , 46 , 31 ] , such channels sit inside the dynamics and are trained only through the world model’s own objectives, with no relation labels.
Nothing in a latent-prediction objective, however, says what they should mean.
A predictor is as well served by a static code, or by one that changes without tracking anything, as by a code for the relations: the symbol grounding problem [ 18 ] , inside a world model.
To our knowledge, no prior work has tested whether relational channels in a world model learn meaningful relationships from real videos, or which training signals help them do so.
blocks.zh:
一个直接的补救措施是把关系建入状态:对于每一个被订购的对实体,一个软符号的小矢量,我们称之为关系道,预测器像其他潜伏体一样消耗和预测.
与神经-同义管不同,这种管线读取由受监督的头部代表[24,46,31]的上游,这种管线坐落在动力学内部,只能通过世界模型自己的目标来训练,没有关系标签.
然而,在潜在预测目标中,没有任何内容说明它们的含义。
一个预测器与一个静态的代码一样,或者一个不跟踪任何东西而变化的代码,就像一个关系代码:符号定位问题 [18],在一个世界模型内.
据我们所知,没有以前的工作检验世界模式中的关系频道是否从真实的视频中学习有意义的关系,或者哪些培训信号帮助他们这样做。

blocks.en:
We study this question with Inside-JEPA ( ).
Our method adds one term to the JEPA objective, an inverse-dynamics loss in which a head must recover the action from the relational channels before and after it, so that the action labels an action-conditioned world model consumes anyway must explain how its relational channels change.
To find out what grounds the channels, we compare five models that differ only in whether and where the inverse gradient enters the state and in whether its targets are shuffled ( Fig. 2 ), plus label-free and label-fraction controls.
Because post-hoc channel matching makes it easy to find meaning that is not there, each relation is matched to a single channel, and every model is also scored with its relation head replaced by a randomly initialised one, which sees the same box geometry ( Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们与内部JEPA一起研究这一问题(.)。
我们的方法为JEPA的目标增加了一个术语,即逆向动力学损失,在这种损失中,头头必须从前后的关系渠道中取回动作,这样动作标出一个行动条件世界模型所消耗的,无论如何都必须解释它的关系渠道是如何变化的.
为了找出频道的根据,我们比较了五个模式,这些模式仅在反向梯度是否和在哪里进入状态以及其目标是否被洗涤(图2),加上无标签和有标签的违章控制上存在差异.
因为Hoc后频道相匹配使得它很容易找到不存在的意义,所以每个关系都匹配到一个频道,每个模型也用其关系头来取而代之,被随机关闭的频道所取而代之,它可以看到相同的框几何(图3).

blocks.en:
Across a controlled 2-D world, Something-Something V2 with Something-Else boxes [ 13 , 32 ] , RH20T robot episodes [ 12 ] and objects found by an off-the-shelf detector and tracker [ 28 , 37 ] , the pattern is the same ( Fig. 4 ).
Latent prediction alone leaves the channels at or near the level of a random relation head, or below it.
Inverse dynamics grounds them: matched relational AUROC rises by .065–.103 in ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on robot episodes with end-effector actions and held-out tasks, and by .050–.061 with tracked objects on five relations; the gain is positive in all 18 settings of Fig. 4 and smallest with tracked objects on thirteen relations and with a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder (+.016 to +.042).
What grounds them is correct action labels that the channels themselves must explain: an inverse head on the entity latents decodes the action best of all models yet barely moves the channels, and shuffled labels, two label-free objectives and labels on 5% of the pairs do not ground them.
The grounded channels are useful: given an action, their forecasts of the relations that change score almost as well as the observed future, and a readout of the 16 channels selects actions towards relational goals better than a readout of the prediction-only model’s whole latent (top-5 .425 vs . .244, frequency prior .174).
blocks.zh:
在受控的二维世界中,Something-Something V2带有Something-Else boxs [13,32],RH20T机器人事件[12],由现成的探测器和跟踪器发现的物体[28,37],模式相同(图4).
仅Latet预测就会使通道处于或接近于随机关系头的水平上,或低于它.
反向动态为它们打下基础:对应关系AUROC在10个环境中上升了0.65-103分并附有附加说明的框;对应机器人发生时的0.81分并带有最终效果动作和被搁置的任务;对应0.50-061分在5个关系中有跟踪物体;在图4的所有18个环境中,收益是正向的,最小的是13个关系中有跟踪物体,并且有一个被冻结的V-JEPA 2编码器(+.016至+.042)。
其依据是频道本身必须解释的正确的动作标签: 实体上一个反向头可以解码所有模型中最优的动作, 却几乎不移动频道, 并打乱了标签, 两个没有标签的目标, 以及5%的对子上的标签不能打倒它们。
固定的频道是有用的:鉴于一个行动,它们预测变化关系的程度几乎与观察到的未来相同,而且16个频道的读出比只读出预测模型的整个潜伏状态(上-5.425 vs. 2.244,频率前为174)更能选择关系目标的行动。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Inside-JEPA , a JEPA world model with relational channels inside its latent state, and evidence that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground those channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone ( INV-S ) or as part of the full state ( INV-Z ) ( Sec. 3 ). • A controlled account of what grounds the channels : five models that differ only in their inverse head, on two datasets with two kinds of action and with automatically found objects, scored by one-to-one matched AUROC and against a random relation head. Grounding needs an inverse head that reads the channels and correct action labels on thousands of pairs; latent prediction, shuffled labels and two label-free losses do not ground them ( Secs. 5.1 and 5.2 ). • Uses and limits of the grounded channels : action-conditioned forecasting and one-step action selection towards relational goals on Something-Else, and a measured account of where grounding stops: left/right, a distributed code, a stronger encoder and a supervised ceiling ( Secs. 5.3 and 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:在JEPA内部,一个JEPA世界模型,其潜在状态下具有关系渠道,并且有证据表明,当其头部单独读取(INV-S)或作为全状态的一部分读取(INV-Z)(第3节)时,反向动力学损失可以打倒这些渠道,而不会打上关系标签。 铺地需要一个反向头来读取频道并正确贴有上千对的动作标签;潜在的预测、洗发标签和两个无标签损失不能铺地(第5.1和5.2条)。 固定渠道的使用和限制:行动有条件的预测和一步一步的行动选择,以达到 " 其它事物 " 的关联目标,并衡量停放地点:左/右、分布式代码、更强大的编码器和有监督的上限(第5.3和5.4节)。

blocks.en: Inside-JEPA , a JEPA world model with relational channels inside its latent state, and evidence that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground those channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone ( INV-S ) or as part of the full state ( INV-Z ) ( Sec. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 在JEPA内部,一个JEPA世界模型,其潜在状态下具有关系渠道,并且有证据表明,当其头部单独(INV-S)或作为完整状态(INV-Z)的一部分(第3节)读取时,反向动力学损失可以打倒这些通道而无关系标签。

blocks.en: A controlled account of what grounds the channels : five models that differ only in their inverse head, on two datasets with two kinds of action and with automatically found objects, scored by one-to-one matched AUROC and against a random relation head. Grounding needs an inverse head that reads the channels and correct action labels on thousands of pairs; latent prediction, shuffled labels and two label-free losses do not ground them ( Secs. 5.1 and 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 控制下描述频道的原理: 5个模型只不同于反向头部,在两个有两种动作的数据集上和自动发现的物体上,由一对一匹配的AUROC来打分,并对应随机关系头. 地平面需要一个反向头来读取频道并正确标出上千对的动作标签;潜在的预测、被洗刷的标签和两个无标签的损失不会被地平面(第5.1和5.2条)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
JEPAs predict target-encoder embeddings instead of pixels [ 26 , 4 , 8 ] ; V-JEPA 2 adds action conditioning and plans with it [ 5 ] ; DINO-WM and navigation world models plan in the feature space of pretrained encoders [ 49 , 7 ] ;
and model-based RL learns action-conditioned latent dynamics [ 16 , 15 , 17 ] .
All keep unstructured vector states.
We keep the JEPA objective and ask what relational channels in its state come to mean.
blocks.zh:
JEPAs预测目标编码器的嵌入而不是像素 [26, 4, 8]; V-JEPA 2 添加了动作调节和计划 5]; DINO-WM和导航世界模型计划 预训编码器的特征空间 [49, 7];
基于模型的RL学习了行动条件的潜在动力[16、15、17]。
全部保持无结构向量状态 。
我们保持《联合环境保护法》的客观,并询问《联合环境保护法》中的关系渠道的含义。

blocks.en:
Interaction networks model physics over given objects and relations [ 9 ] ; C-SWM learns object-factored transitions with a contrastive loss [ 23 ] ; slot models discover objects without boxes [ 30 , 22 , 39 ] and roll them forward [ 45 ] .
Scene graphs and their spatio-temporal versions describe pairwise relations with supervised predicates [ 46 , 21 ] , and neuro-symbolic reasoners execute programs over such structure [ 31 , 47 ] .
Our relational channels are pairwise like a scene graph but trained without relation labels and part of the dynamics state; our learned-object experiments try slots, then a detector and tracker.
blocks.zh:
交互网络模型物理在给定对象和关系上进行学习[9];C-SWM学习对象因子而发生具有对比性损失的过渡[23];插槽模型发现没有框的物体[30,22,39]并滚动[45].
场景图及其斯皮提奥-时态版本描述了与被监管的上游的对等关系[46,21],神经-同义推理器通过这种结构执行程序[31,47].
我们的关系通道是双向的,就像一个场景图,但训练时没有关系标签和动力学状态的一部分;我们的学习对象实验尝试插槽,然后是探测器和跟踪器.

blocks.en:
Latplan learns propositional states from images for classical planning [ 3 ] , and skill-to-symbol methods derive symbols from the preconditions and effects of actions [ 25 ] .
Closest to our setting, Migimatsu and Bohg ground predicate classifiers on Something-Something V2 with Something-Else boxes from action labels alone, turning each action’s hand-written PDDL pre- and post-conditions into partial labels [ 33 ] .
Our inverse loss also ties the channels to what actions do, but needs no hand-written conditions or separate classifier: it is a differentiable term in a JEPA, and its channels are tested on relation labels it never sees.
Because that method needs hand-written conditions for every action, we do not run it; our comparisons hold the architecture fixed and vary only the training signal.
blocks.zh:
Latplan从图像中学习了命题状态,用于古典规划[3],而技能对同义方法则取自动作的前提条件和效果[25].
将每个动作的手写 PDDL 预和后条件变成部分标签。
我们的倒数损失也把渠道与行为相关联, 但不需要手写条件或单独分类:这是JEPA中一个不同的术语,
因为这种方法需要手写条件来进行每个动作,所以我们不运行它;我们的比较使架构固定,只改变训练信号.

blocks.en:
Predicting the action from consecutive observations shapes features for manipulation and exploration [ 1 , 36 ] , pretrains representations for imitation [ 11 ] and labels or infers actions in unlabelled video [ 6 , 38 ] .
Recent work has also incorporated inverse dynamics into JEPA-style world models: as the sole anti-collapse regulariser [ 20 ] , as a contrastive head replacing SIGReg [ 10 ] , as a decoder of actions from latent differences [ 48 ] , or to keep them plannable when little of the frame moves [ 40 ] ; for linear systems, exact action reconstruction provably keeps every state direction reachable within the horizon [ 42 ] .
They shape the whole latent for control, as our INV-Z arm does; we use the term to give chosen channels of the state a meaning, and measure whether it does.
blocks.zh:
从连续观测中预测动作会塑造用于操纵和探索的特征[1,36],用于模仿的预示[11],以及无标签视频中的标签或推断动作[6,38].
近期的工作还将反向动态纳入JEPA风格的世界模型:作为唯一的反碰撞常态器[20],作为取代SIGREG[10]的反相头头,作为从潜在差异中解码动作 [48],或者当框架的微小移动[40]时,保持其可规划性;对于线性系统来说,精确的行动重建可以证明使每一个州的方向都能在地平线内达到[42].
正如我们的INV-Z臂所做的那样,它们塑造了整个潜在控制;我们用这个词给国家选择的渠道一个意义,并衡量它是否有效。

blocks.en:
Concept-bottleneck models supervise concept channels directly [ 24 ] ; linear probes test what a representation encodes [ 2 ] ; and unsupervised factors are not identifiable without inductive bias or supervision [ 29 ] .
We use linear probes, never in training, to check that relational information is present and as planning readouts, and a relation-supervised version of our channels only as a ceiling.
Temporal self-supervision, arrow-of-time classification [ 34 , 44 ] and contrastive prediction [ 43 ] , provides our label-free controls; our InfoNCE control contrasts start and goal channels without the action.
blocks.zh:
概念-瓶颈模型直接监督概念通道 [24];线性探测器测试一种表示编码的是什么 [2];在没有诱导偏差或监督的情况下,未被监督的因素无法识别 [29].
我们用线性探测器,从不训练, 检查关系信息的存在 和作为计划读取, 和关系监督版本 我们的频道只作为一个上限。

blocks.en: 3 Inside-JEPA
blocks.zh: 3 内部JEPA

blocks.en:
Inside-JEPA is a JEPA world model whose state contains one latent per entity and one vector of relational channels per ordered entity pair ( ).
It is trained with the JEPA prediction loss plus an inverse-dynamics loss on the relational channels; no relation label is used.
blocks.zh:
内部-JEPA是一个JEPA世界模型,其状态包含每个实体一个潜在和每个订购实体对一个关系信道的矢量(.)。
它接受过JEPA预测损失以及关系道上逆动力损失的培训;没有使用关系标签。

In Blocks2D, where relations are exact, PRED reaches .522 ± \pm .018 relational AUROC (mean ± \pm SD), below an untrained relation head (.641).
Its channels never flip (rate 0.000 against 0.021 in the ground truth), and copying the current channels predicts the next ones as well as the predictor does: it has learned a stable, perfectly predictable code that likely encodes object identity or colour rather than relations.
Inverse dynamics removes this shortcut: .728 ± \pm .009 in the same sweep and .756 ± \pm .008 in a separate matched sweep ( PRED .519), and the gain holds on held-out object counts and taller stacks and when vertical lifts rule out a horizontal-motion shortcut ( App. D ).
blocks.zh:
在关系准确的Blocks2D中,PRED达到522±\pm.018关系AUROC(平均值±\pm SD),低于未受训练的关系头(641).
它的频道从不翻转(在地上真实度为0.000对0.021),并复制了目前的频道预测了接下来的频道以及预测器所做的:它已经学会了一个稳定,完全可以预测的代码,可能编码对象身份或颜色而不是关系.
反向动态移除了这个快捷键:同为扫码的728 ±\pm.009和相隔相隔相隔的扫码(PRED 519)的756 ±\pm.008,而被搁置对象计数和高架堆积的增益,当垂直升降排除了横向运动快捷键(App. D.).

blocks.en:
On Something-Else (40 templates, five relations), PRED goes wrong in another way: its channels flip at about the true rate (.24 against .21) but do not track the relations, and they score exactly as well as a random relation head (.536, margin +.000). INV-S reaches .634, a gain of +.097 (about seven seed SDs, pooled over PRED and INV-S ), with a margin gain of +.092 (2 SE .022), and INV-SHUF , trained on shuffled action labels, scores .116 below it (2 SE .016).
A linear probe reads the relations from every arm’s pair features (.86–.93), so the information is there even where the channels do not carry it.
blocks.zh:
在Something-Else(40个模板,5个关系)上,PRED以另一种方式出错:它的频道翻转率大约为真实率(24对.21),但没有跟踪关系,它们得分准确,以及随机关系头(536,比值+.000). INV-S达到634分,收益为+.097分(约7个种子SD,集合于PRED和INV-S上),比分收益为+.092分(2SE.02),INV-SHUF则接受洗牌动作标签培训,得分为下方.116分(2SE.016)。
线性探测器从每个臂的对接特征(.86–.93)读取关系,因此即使没有渠道携带信息,信息也存在。

blocks.en:
With annotated boxes and a ResNet-18 encoder, the gain replicates in all ten settings of Fig. 4 (top), from +.065 to +.103: on all 65 templates, with three times the epochs, with the backbone fine-tuned (weaker, +.068), with an action-conditioned predictor, on thirteen relations, on 12.5% of the data and on all 174 Something-Something templates (3 × \times the pairs).
In every one of these settings the margin gain exceeds 2 SE (+.054 to +.095; Tab. 3 ).
Trained on steps of about 1 s instead of frame pairs that span the clip, the gain shrinks to +.037 ( App. H ).
It replicates on RH20T, where the action is an end-effector displacement and whole tasks are held out: +.081, with a margin gain of +.084 (2 SE .038); with one camera per setup it is +.046 (five seeds; App. F ).
It survives replacing the annotated boxes with detector-and-tracker objects, scored on tracks matched to annotated objects: +.061 on 40 templates and +.052 on 65 (+.050 with two extra seeds).
Scored without any annotation at test time, the same models gain +.047 on 65 templates and +.048 on 40, with the margin gain and the lead over INV-SHUF still beyond 2 SE ( App. E ).
The gain is smaller with tracked objects on thirteen relations (+.038) and with a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder.

被训练了大约1 s 的阶梯,而不是横跨剪辑的帧对,增益收缩到+.037 (App. H.).
它在RH20T上复制,在RH20T上动作是最终效果的移位并承担了全部任务:+.081,边角增益为+.084(2SE.038);每个设置一个相机是+.046(5个种子;App.F.).
它活了下来,用探测器和跟踪器的物体来取代附加说明的盒子,在与附加说明的物体相匹配的轨道上得分:在40个模板上得到+.061分,在65上得到+.052分(+.050分得到两个额外的种子).

blocks.en: 5.2 Q2: What grounds the channels
blocks.zh: 5.2 问题2:何以为频道提供依据?

blocks.en: Figure 5 : What drives grounding (main setup: 65 templates, 13 relations, annotated boxes). (a) Per-relation gain of INV-S over PRED ( ± \pm 2 SE, 3 seeds): contact, proximity and vertical relations ground; left_of , much_larger and the hand relations do not. (b) Nested fractions of the training data, all labelled (3 seeds): more data lifts PRED more than INV-S . (c) All data, with action labels on a fraction of the pairs (5 seeds): labels lift INV-S ; PRED has no inverse loss, so its solid line is a single value; dashed: the predictor also sees only the labelled pairs’ actions.

blocks.en:
INV-R ’s inverse head reads only the entity latents, so its gradient reaches the channels only through the shared encoder.
On the main setup it decodes the action best of all arms (top-1 .424, against .396 for INV-Z and .316 for INV-S ), yet its channels barely ground (.608 vs . PRED ’s .593; Tab. 1 ).
In the setting of the first real-video test and with the action-conditioned predictor, its margin gain over PRED is +.022 and +.024 (2 SE .016 and .012), beyond noise but about a quarter of INV-S ’s, and on all 174 templates its channels stay at PRED ’s level (.622 vs . .623).
What matters is that the inverse head reads the channels, not that it reads only them: INV-Z , which reads the whole latent as recent inverse-dynamics terms in JEPA world models do [ 20 , 48 , 40 ] , grounds about as well as INV-S or better wherever both ran (.654 vs . .634 in the first real-video test, .670 vs . .658 on the main setup).
blocks.zh:
INV-R反向头只读取实体潜入,所以它的梯度只能通过共享编码器到达通道.
在主要装置上,它解码了所有武器中最好的动作(INV-Z对396起,INV-S对316起),但其信道几乎没落(608起对PRED的5.93起;Tab. 1起)。
在设定第一次真实录像测试时,并使用行动条件的预测器,其比PRED的比值是+.022和+.024(2SE.016和0.12),超出噪音,但约为INV-S的四分之一;在所有174个模板上,其信道停留在PRED的水平(622对6.23)。
重要的是反向头读出频道,而不是只读出频道:INV-Z,它读取了整个潜在,就像JEPA世界模型中最近的反向动力学术语[20,48,40]一样,无论在什么地方,INV-S或更好(第一次真实视频测试中的654 vs. 634, 670 vs.

No control that keeps the route but replaces the action labels grounds the channels ( Tab. 2 ).
Shuffled labels never ground ( − - .057).
Two label-free losses on the same channels learn their own tasks (arrow of time .661 against chance .5; InfoNCE top-1 .839 against .016) but do not ground them ( − - .007 and +.010), and both fall short of INV-S by more than 2 SE.
Our reading, which we did not test, is that both tasks can be solved from object appearance and motion without encoding the relations.

blocks.en:
With every pair present but labels on a nested, template-stratified fraction, labels on 1% or 5% of the pairs give no measurable grounding gain ( − - .002 and +.008), although at 5% the action effect and planning already rise ( Tab. 2 ).
The gain rises between 5% and 25%: labels on 25% of the pairs (3,490, about 54 per template) give +.047 (2 SE .009), against +.066 with all labels, and over all four fractions the gain grows by .011 per doubling (2 SE .002).
Hiding the unlabelled pairs’ actions from the predictor too gives the same gains ( App. G ).
Labels and data act differently ( Fig. 5 b,c): more training data lifts PRED from .531 to .593 while INV-S changes less (.620 to .658), whereas more labels lift INV-S and leave PRED , which has no inverse loss, flat (.597–.598 when it too sees only the labelled pairs’ actions).
The thirteen-relation gain shrinks with data only because PRED learns the two hand relations; the other eleven keep about +.10 from 25% of the data upward, a split found post hoc and confirmed at two new training-set sizes ( App. C ).
blocks.zh:
在一个嵌入的、模板级分数上每一对现出但有标签,在1%或5%的配对上贴出标签,不会带来可衡量的地基收益(--.002和+.008),尽管行动效果和规划已经上升了5%(Tab. 2)。
增益在5%至25%之间:在25%的对子(3,490个,每个模板约54个)上的标签给出了+.047(2SE.009个),而所有标签都是+.066,在所有4个分子上,增益每加倍增加0.011个(2SE.002)。
从预测器中隐藏无标签的对子动作也带来同样的收益(App.G.).
标签和数据作用不同(图5b:c):更多的培训数据将PRED从531升至593,而INV-S的变动更小(从620升至658),而更多的标签将INV-S升至并离开没有倒数损失的PRED,平平平(597–598,当它也只看到有标签的对子的行为时 ) 。
13-关系增益只因为PRED学习了双手关系而随着数据而收缩;另外11个则从25%的数据向上保持了约+.10,一个分数发现后特有,并在两个新的训练集大小(App. C.)中确认.

blocks.en:
Something-Something templates name the outcome in words, so the inverse loss might be relation supervision in disguise.
A template does not say which channel should carry which relation, and on RH20T, where the action is a 6-D end-effector displacement plus the gripper change, grounding replicates, again carried by contact and proximity ( near +.22, overlap +.10, above +.07, inside +.05, left_of − - .03).
blocks.zh:
某事-某事模板用文字来命名结果,因此倒数损失可能是伪装中的关系监督.
一个模板没有说明哪个信道应承接哪一种关系,在RH20T上,如果动作是6-D端效应相位移,加上抓取器的改变,则地面复制,再次由接触和相近(接近+.22,重叠+.10上+.07,在+.05,左---.03)携带。

blocks.en:
The gain is largest for contact and proximity ( Fig. 5 a): overlap , far , near and near_tight gain .13–.20, and the vertical relations strictly_above , y_overlap and above gain .07–.13, while left_of , much_larger and the hand relations gain nothing or lose.
Across datasets and object sources, overlap and near always gain and left_of never does, while the other relations vary ( Fig. 8 ); inside , for instance, gains in five of six settings but not on all 174 templates ( − - .046).
A probe reads left_of from the same latents (.93 from PRED ’s on RH20T).
On Something-Else, how much a relation’s change tells about the action predicts its gain (rank correlation +.90 and +.82 on two relation sets), but not on RH20T ( − - .30), so we offer no general account.

blocks.en:
Without the action as input, forecasts of the relations that change stay near chance (.516 for INV-S , .46–.54 across arms).
With it ( Fig. 6 a), INV-S ’s forecasts score .599 on the changing entries, close to the channels observed in the future frame (.621), and fall to .511 with a permuted action, an action effect of +.088.
Arms with ungrounded channels barely use the same input ( PRED +.003, INV-R +.009).
The result holds on 65 templates (.579 vs . .610 observed) and with tracked objects (.560 vs . .569), and when the predictor is rolled forward in steps of about 1 s the action effect grows from +.021 after one step to +.057 after three ( App. H ).
On RH20T, forecasts depend on the action, losing .095 when it is permuted, but reach only .518 ( App. F ).
blocks.zh:
没有作为投入的行动,预测变化中的关系几乎是偶然的(INV-S, 516起,46起至54起跨越武器)。
有了它(图6a),INV-S的预测值在变化的条目上得分为599分,接近未来框架所观察到的频道(621分),并倒入了511分并带有被渗透动作,动作效果为+.088.
无底通道的武器很少使用相同的输入(PRED+.003,INV-R+.009)。
其结果存在于65个模板(579 vs. 610 observed)和有跟踪物体(560 vs. 569)上,当预测器向前滚动约 1 s 步时,动作效果从一个步骤后+.021增长到3后+.057 (App. H.).
在RH20T上,预测取决于动作,被穿透后会损失0.095,但只达到518(App.F.

blocks.en:
We test one-step action selection: given the start state and the relations at the end of the clip as the goal, the candidates are ranked by how well each one’s forecast matches the goal.
With calibrated one-channel scoring ( Chan ), INV-S ranks the true template in its top five for 33% of goals, and for 37% when its inverse head scores the candidates ( Inv ); PRED , INV-SHUF and INV-R stay below the .174 frequency prior with Chan .
blocks.zh:
我们测试一个步骤的动作选择:鉴于片段的起始状态和作为目标的片尾关系,候选人的排名以每个人的预测是否与目标相符为准。
INV-S通过校正一通道得分(Chan ),将真实的模板排在前5位,达到33%的入球率,而当逆向头部得分时,则排名为37%(Inv);PRED,INV-SHUF和INV-R在Chan 之前的174个频率下方.

blocks.en:
A linear probe on INV-S ’s 16 relational channels ( Probe-S ) plans at .425 ( Fig. 6 b), as well as one on its whole latent (.416) and better than one on its entity latents (.316), whereas a probe on PRED ’s whole latent reaches .244. INV-R ’s channels, trained with the same loss routed around them, plan at .209.
About 140 relation-labelled pairs (1%) suffice to fit INV-S ’s readouts ( Probe-S .415 vs . .425 with all pairs), whereas PRED ’s whole-latent probe falls to .179 ( Fig. 6 c).
With tracked objects, Chan still plans above the prior (.273; .219 with no annotations), although their thirteen-relation gain is smaller (+.038).
The advantage does not depend on the caption’s role order either: with annotated boxes (five relations, five seeds), the channel probe beats PRED ’s whole latent by +.174 with the objects shuffled and +.175 in caption order, both with the hand last, and by +.116 with the hand first.
Among all 174 templates the one-channel readout falls to the prior, while the inverse head and the channel probe still plan above it ( App. C ).
On RH20T, a probe on any arm’s latent, PRED ’s included, plans best (.213–.229, the best within .008 of a model-free oracle), partly because there is little headroom ( near holds in 98% of pairs) and partly because the goals are positional and positions enter every arm’s entity latents; we claim relational planning for Something-Else only.
blocks.zh:
对INV-S的16个关系道(探测-S)的线性探测器(图6b),以及整个潜伏道(图416)和更好的实体潜伏道(316)的线性探测器,而PRED的整个潜伏道的探测器达到244。 INV-R的频道在209年计划时接受过同样损失的训练。
大约140个贴有关系标签的对子(1%)足以满足INV-S的读取量(Probe-S 415 vs. 425配对),而PRED的全相位探测器则会降到179个(图6c)。
带着跟踪物体 陈仍计划高于前作(273;219没有说明),尽管他们的十三相关系增益较小(+.038)。
优点也不取决于标题的角色顺序:有注解的框(5个关系,5个种子),频道探测器用+174和+.175按标题顺序击败了PRED的整个潜伏状态,两者都用倒数和+.
在所有174个模板中,单声道读取属于前一个,而反向头和频道探测器仍计划在其上方(App.C.).
在RH20T上,包括PRED在内的任何手臂潜入的探测器,计划最好(213–229,无模型甲骨文的.008范围内最好的),部分原因是头室很小(几乎占98 % ) , 部分原因是目标位置,位置进入了每个手臂的实体潜入;我们声称只有其他事物的关系规划。

Five explanations that we tested are not supported: captions that name no direction, cameras that disagree on image left/right, no left/right information in the action, the action in the wrong frame and too few channels ( Tab. 12 ).

With frozen V-JEPA 2 features [ 5 ] on still frames, the gain is +.050 at three seeds and +.042 at five, against +.065 with ResNet-18.
With 16 frames of video context it falls to +.016 (five seeds), as PRED rises (.601 to .625) while INV-S stays level (.643 to .641); the goal frame’s features then reveal the action through motion (an action probe on them rises from .479 to .566), and a still goal frame restores the inverse head’s accuracy but not the gain (+.021).

Channel-probe planning holds throughout (.390–.399 vs . .252–.308 for PRED ).

Channels trained on the relation labels reach .998, as the relations are near-exact functions of the box coordinates.
Inverse dynamics recovers .16 of that ceiling’s gain over PRED with one-channel matching and .37 with a channel probe (V-JEPA 2: .12 and .25): about a third for contact and proximity with matching and about half with a probe, and little or none for left_of , much_larger and the hand relations.
Yet the inverse-trained channels plan as well as the supervised ones through a probe (.424 vs . .393), although the supervised ones show about twice the action effect when forecasting relational change (.223 vs . .103; App. J ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
With architecture, data and budget fixed, inverse dynamics on the relational channels aligns them with relations that latent prediction leaves them free to ignore, on caption-labelled video, on robot episodes with end-effector actions and, more weakly, with tracked objects.
This needs an inverse head that reads the channels and correct action labels on thousands of pairs.
Grounding here means that one channel per relation scores above PRED and above a random relation head against relations computed from boxes; it does not show that the channels represent physical relations beyond what the boxes define.
Nor do the experiments show why particular relations ground: our design rationale ( Sec. 3.3 ) fits Something-Else, where the relations whose change reveals the action gain most, but not RH20T.
The two label-free objectives we tried learn their tasks without grounding the channels; that does not rule out every label-free objective.
blocks.zh:
随着结构、数据和预算的固定,关系频道的反向动态使其与潜在的预测关系一致,从而使其在字幕标签的视频中可以随意忽略带有最终效果动作的机器人事件,以及更弱的跟踪物体。
这需要一个反向的头来读取频道,并纠正上千对的动作标签.
定位于此意味着每个关系分数高于PRED的频道和随机关系头高于从框中计算出的关系;它没有显示这些频道代表的物理关系超出了框所定义的范围.
实验也没有显示为什么特定的关系基础:我们的设计原理(第3.3节)符合“其他东西”,其中,其变化揭示了动作的关系获得的利益最大,但RH20T却并非如此。
我们尝试的两个无标签目标在不破坏渠道的情况下学习他们的任务;这不排除每一个无标签的目标.

blocks.en:
A world model trained for control receives actions anyway.
Our results suggest that making relational channels explain those actions is a practical way to give them meaning, and that doing so turns them into a compact readout for stating goals ( Fig. 6 b).
Recent JEPA world models already add inverse-dynamics terms on the whole latent [ 20 , 10 , 48 , 40 ] ; our INV-Z arm suggests that such terms also ground relational channels placed inside the state, as long as the inverse head reads them.

接受过控制训练的世界模式总能接受行动。
我们的结果表明,通过关系渠道来解释这些行动是赋予它们意义的一个实际办法,这样做会把它们变成一个紧凑的朗读,以说明目标(图6b)。
最近的JEPA世界模型已经在整个潜在[20, 10, 48, 40] 上添加了反向动力学术语;我们的INV-Z臂表示,只要反向头读取这些术语,这些术语也会在州内放置地上关系道.

blocks.en: Scope : a controlled study against one baseline, PRED , with the architecture held fixed; we ran no other relational or inverse-dynamics method, and INV-Z stands in for whole-latent inverse dynamics. Data and horizons : one human-video dataset with annotated boxes and one robot dataset, whose boxes are correct in 34 of 40 hand-checked frames; the Something-Something action is a caption; horizons are within clips of about 4 s. Objects : with tracked objects the effect is half to two-thirds as large (+.061 and +.052 on 40 and 65 templates, against +.096 and +.102 with annotated boxes); missed objects explain most of the gap, and the caption’s role order, encoded in Something-Else’s entity order but unknown to a tracker, part of the rest ( App. E ); on RH20T, automatically found boxes were correct in at most 18 of 40 hand-checked frames, so the robot result rests on the given boxes. Effect size : gains of .02–.10 and .12–.37 of a supervised ceiling are modest, although the test is strict (one channel per relation, against an identical architecture), and the channels form a distributed code, not clean predicates. Encoders and training : frozen backbones except one fine-tuned run, where the effect is weaker; with V-JEPA 2 the gain is smaller (+.042); one budget and loss weight; three to five seeds. Planning : one-step action selection within a clip, with readouts fitted on relation-labelled pairs, on Something-Else only.
blocks.zh: 范围:对照一个基线(PRED)进行控制研究,并固定结构;我们没有使用其他关系或反向动力学方法,INV-Z代表全相向反向动力学。 数据与地平线:一个带有注解框的人体-视频数据集和一个机器人数据集,其取材框在40个手检框中的34个中正确;Something-Something动作是一个标题;地平线在大约4 s. Objects的片段内:有跟踪对象的效果为大半至三分之二(40和65个模板上的+.061和+.052,对+.096和+.102有注解框);被忽略的物体解释大部分缺口,以及标题的作用顺序,编码在Something-Else的实体顺序中,但对于一个追踪器,其余部分(App.E.)来说是未知的;在RH20T上,在40个手检框中大多数的18个中自动发现盒子是正确的,因此机器人结果存在于给定框上。 效果大小:受监管天花板的增益为.02-10和12-37是适度的,虽然测试很严格(每个关系一个频道,相对一个相同的架构),频道形成一个分布式代码,而不是干净的上游. 编码员和培训员:冷冻骨干,但一次微调跑道,效果较弱;V-JEPA 2的增益较小(+.042);一次预算和减重;3至5个种子. 规划:在剪辑内进行一步动作选择,在关系标签上配对,只在Something-Else上配对。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Relational channels inside a JEPA world model do not become meaningful by being there: latent prediction leaves them free to mean nothing.
Making them explain the action aligns them with the relations, on caption-labelled video, on robot episodes and with automatically found objects, provided the inverse head reads the channels and enough actions are labelled.
The grounded channels forecast how actions change relations and carry the signal for selecting actions towards relational goals: selectively, as a distributed code, and at a level that a stronger encoder lets the plain predictor approach.
We hope that the controlled comparisons, and the negative results reported beside the positive ones, make Inside-JEPA a sound starting point for world models whose states can be read and given goals in relational terms.
blocks.zh:
JEPA世界模型内的关系渠道因存在而变得毫无意义:潜伏的预测使得它们没有意义。
让他们解释动作与关系, 在字幕标签的视频上, 在机器人事件上, 和自动发现的对象上,
被封闭的渠道预测行动如何改变关系,并带有选择行动实现关系目标的信号:有选择地,作为一个分布式代码,在一个更强的编码器可以让平坦的预测器方法的层面上.
我们希望,有控制的比较,以及除正面比较外报告的负面结果,使日本环保局内部成为世界模型的合理起点,其状态可以从相关角度来解读和确定目标。

Fitting the matching on training pairs instead leaves Chan unchanged (at most − - .015, with labels on 1% of the pairs).
The random-head reference replaces the trained relation head g g with a freshly initialised one (seed 0), applied to the checkpoint’s own entity embeddings and evaluated identically; with box coordinates in the input it scores .52–.60 per relation.
The probe is a linear classifier per relation on each arm’s pair features; C4 requires probe AUROC ≥ .75 \geq.75 in every arm.

blocks.en:
Candidates are all templates (40, 65 or 174); the rank of the true action is one plus the number of candidates with a strictly better score.
References are chance (5/65 = .077), a template-frequency prior (.174 on 65 templates) and a model-free oracle that compares each template’s mean ground-truth relation change in training with the pair’s actual change. Dist scores a candidate by the squared distance between forecast matched channels and goal relations. Chan scores the likelihood of the goal relations under per-relation logistic calibrations of the forecast matched channels. Inv (amortised inverse) maps the goal relations into channel space through per-channel class means of the matched channels, fitted on training pairs, and gives the start channels and this goal to the arm’s inverse head; candidates are ranked by its output. Probe-Z , Probe-S and Probe-R score the goal under per-relation linear logistic probes on the forecast pair features ( r i , r j , s i ​ j ) (r_{i},r_{j},s_{ij}) , on s i ​ j s_{ij} only, or on ( r i , r j ) (r_{i},r_{j}) only.
Readouts are fitted on labelled training pairs; about 140 (1%) suffice for Chan and Inv , and Probe-Z gains +.030 from 1% to 100% for INV-S .
On RH20T, whose inverse head regresses a control, Inv ranks the 40 candidate controls by their distance to its output.

Inv(分级反向)通过匹配频道的每个频道课堂手段将目标关系映射到频道空间,并安装在训练对上,将起始频道和这个目标交给臂反向头;候选人按其产出排名。 Probe-Z, Probe-S和 Probe-R 在关系线性物流探测器下对预测对等特征(r i, r j, s i j (r_{i}i}), r_{j}j}, s_{ijj})的入球得分, 或仅对 (r ii, r ji}j})的入球.

RH20T的反向头反向一个控制,在RH20T上,因夫以40个候选控制与其输出的相距来排名.

blocks.en:
With five relations, grounded arms planned better than ungrounded ones on 40 templates ( INV-S .234 vs . PRED .130; prior .194, oracle .298) but did not beat the prior on 65 templates, and with thirteen relations even the 40-template margin over the prior fell just inside 2 SE (.228 vs . .194).
An evaluation-only analysis then showed that raw distance scoring was the cause (calibrated Chan .363 and Inv .456 on the 40-template, thirteen-relation checkpoints), and the calibrated planners were locked before the 65-template replication.
blocks.zh:

之后只进行评价分析,发现原始距离分数是原因(40通关口上为Chan 363分和Inv 456分,13通关口上为正关口),而65通关口复制前已锁定了校正规划人员.

Of the 5,497 annotated entities (objects and hands) still missed on 65-template validation, 3,080 were detected but not among the four tracks kept, 1,209 were never detected and 1,208 were lost in tracking; keeping a fifth track recovers objects but adds as many distractors (42% to 52% of kept tracks) and does not change the gain (+.083 vs . +.080); choosing tracks by proximity to the hand did not reduce distractors on validation.

Crossing training and test objects on the same validation pairs ( Tab. 11 ) shows that, in the tracker’s format, neither training nor testing on annotated boxes moves the gain beyond 2 SE.
The hand flag adds nothing; listing the hand last helps with annotated boxes but not with tracked objects, and with tracked objects the detector’s hand flag hurts (+.025 vs . +.045).
Something-Else lists a clip’s objects in the order of the caption’s placeholders (categories match the caption order in 92.4% of training videos), so the hand-last order also fixes each object slot’s role.
At five seeds, randomising the object order with the hand last costs .027 (2 SE .026; lower for every seed), and moving the hand first costs about as much again (.025, 2 SE .028); this split is post hoc.
The role order mainly helps inside and above ; INV-Z barely changes across the three orders (.627–.640) while INV-S moves from .600 to .651, so a stable slot per role matters more for the relational channels than for the whole latent (descriptive).
Ordering tracked objects by the caption’s nouns (Grounding DINO tiny on the placeholder strings, no boxes read) puts 70.0% of object pairs in role order, against .381 for the detector’s score order, short of the locked .75 bar; nothing was trained.
For planning with annotated boxes (5 relations, K = 8 K=8 , so not like-for-like with Fig. 6 ), a probe on INV-S ’s relational channels plans at .340 top-5 with the objects in random order, against .166 for PRED ’s whole latent (+.174, 2 SE .022, positive in every seed); caption order adds +.051 and raises PRED by about as much (+.049, descriptive).
Given-box levels therefore include role information from the annotations, but the advantage that grounding gives does not depend on it, and since the format is identical across arms it changes the level of grounding, not the comparison.

34 of 40 audited frames were correct (one object box on a cloth pattern; five boxes too small or occluded to judge), against a planned bar of 36.
The looser bar ( ≥ 34 / 40 \geq 34/40 , at most two clearly wrong) was set after this audit; it and the rule that a failure would make the experiment inconclusive were fixed before any training.
Boxes from an off-the-shelf detector and tracker failed the original, stricter check (36 of 40 frames, no box on the background) before any training.
Grounding DINO base and SAM 2.1 large tracks (prompt “robot gripper. object.”), run on a fixed sample of 1,999 validation pairs, passed the check in 5 of 40 audited frames: their gripper boxes covered the arm, or the gripper together with what it held.
Taking the gripper box from the robot’s recorded pose and RH20T’s camera calibration, and prompting the detector with each task’s object nouns, fixed the gripper (fingertip boxes in about 34 of 40 frames) and raised manipulated-object coverage at IoU ≥ .5 \geq.5 from 19% to 31%, but frame-sized or merged object boxes remained, and the check reached only 18 of 40.
The robot result therefore rests on the given boxes, and how much it depends on them is untested.

Loss weights were set so that each loss matches the inverse loss at initialisation ( λ aot = 5.98 \lambda_{\text{aot}}=5.98 , λ nce = 1.00 \lambda_{\text{nce}}=1.00 ).
A held-out training-split check before launch gave arrow-of-time accuracy .688 and InfoNCE top-1 .899; on validation, .661 and .839.
Gains over PRED are − - .007 and +.010 at five seeds (the locked seed rule fired at three); both fall short of INV-S by .072 (2 SE .005) and .056 (2 SE .008).
Each gives a small gain on a few relations (arrow of time: near +.061, near_tight +.077; InfoNCE: inside +.080, a_covers_half_b +.081, much_larger +.070); on contact and proximity as a group they gain +.035 and +.029, against +.138 for inverse dynamics ( Fig. 11 ).

blocks.en:
In the grounded model the relational information sits in the 16 relational channels, but each relation is spread over several of them ( Fig. 12 a): the one-channel readout Chan plans at .334 and the 16-channel probe Probe-S at .425.
Three label-free attempts to give each relation its own channel failed ( Fig. 12 b).
A decorrelation penalty (the mean squared off-diagonal entry of the channel correlation matrix, with its weight chosen without relation labels, on held-out inverse accuracy) decorrelates the channels (mean | | off-diagonal correlation | | .24 to .014) but makes the one-channel readout worse (readout AUROC − - .037; Chan .322 to .234) and drops the grounding gain to +.028, below the bar; nothing is lost from the code as a whole ( Probe-S .430 vs . .427; Inv .368 to .467).
Decorrelation is invariant to rotations of the code, so it can whiten it but not align relations with channels; the penalty alone on PRED lowers its matched AUROC by .038.
A post-hoc ICA rotation , which is rotation-sensitive, also makes the one-channel readout worse (readout AUROC − - .024, 2 SE .015; Chan .322 to .277, within noise), and a sparsity penalty cuts active channels per pair from 8 to 2.4 but destroys grounding (+.005), planning ( Chan .159, Probe-S .304) and the action effect.
The inverse-trained channel axes remain the best one-channel basis we found, and matched AUROC is a lower bound on what the channels hold.

blocks.en:
Frozen V-JEPA 2 ViT-L, self-supervised weights only; entity features are RoIAlign-pooled from the full-frame token map (16 × \times 16 grid) at each box, not taken from box crops; otherwise the main setup (65 templates, 13 relations).
With video context, 16 past frames at 12 fps end at each frame and features come from the last temporal token slice, the one containing that frame, so the boxes stay aligned.
V-JEPA 2’s pretraining mixture includes 168K Something-Something V2 videos, used without labels [ 5 ] , about the size of SSv2’s training split (168,913 videos [ 32 ] ).
Something-Else’s compositional split assigns videos to training and validation by verb–object combination rather than by SSv2’s split [ 32 ] , so 13,057 of the 14,975 validation videos used here (87%) are SSv2 training videos, which the encoder saw during pretraining; the other 1,918 are SSv2 validation videos.
Every arm shares the frozen encoder, so the arms are compared like for like.
To test whether this exposure inflates the scores, we re-scored the 25 still-frame checkpoints (five arms, five seeds) on the 1,918 unseen videos and, as a size-matched reference, on five random 1,918-video samples of the 13,057 seen ones. INV-S ’s margin gain over PRED is +.042 ± \pm .010 on unseen videos and +.045 ± \pm .016 on the matched samples (seed-paired difference − .002 ± .007 -.002\pm.007 ; all ± \pm 2 SE), so the gain is unchanged.
Only INV-Z meets the locked rule for inflation by exposure (a margin lower on unseen than on matched seen videos by more than 2 SE): its margin falls from .088 on the matched samples to .082 on unseen videos ( − .005 ± .003 -.005\pm.003 ), and the ranking of the arms does not change.
Seen and unseen videos also come from different SSv2 splits, so these differences combine exposure and split.
The V-JEPA 2 ceiling in App. J was not re-scored and may be optimistic.

blocks.en:
SUP-S is the same model with relational channel ρ \rho trained with a binary cross-entropy on relation ρ \rho (13 of 16 channels), on ResNet-18 and V-JEPA 2, 3 seeds; a second arm removes the box coordinates from the entity input.
Its locked precondition, a ceiling of at least .85 on ResNet-18, holds (.998; V-JEPA 2 .997): the relations are a near-exact function of the box coordinates in the input.
Share of the ceiling’s gain over PRED recovered by inverse dynamics ( ± \pm 2 SE; ceiling 3 seeds, baselines 5): one-channel matching .160 ± \pm .032 (ResNet-18) and .123 ± \pm .067 (V-JEPA 2); channel probe .371 ± \pm .011 and .252 ± \pm .067.
By group (matching / probe): contact and proximity .32 / .48 (ResNet-18) and .31 / .44 (V-JEPA 2); direction and size .11 / .28 and .03 / .12; little or none for left_of , much_larger (at most .10) and the hand relations; Fig. 13 gives every relation.
Label-trained channels show two to three times the action effect when forecasting relational change (.223 vs . .103 with ResNet-18; .227 vs . .080 with V-JEPA 2) and plan better with the one-channel readout ( Chan .394 vs . .331; .406 vs . .264), but not through a channel probe ( Probe-S .393 vs . .424; .398 vs . .390).
Without box coordinates, label-trained channels on V-JEPA 2 features still read every relation that inverse dynamics missed (.988–.998), so the miss is the objective’s, not the encoder’s; this measures position available through positional embeddings, not relational understanding.
On ResNet-18 without boxes, left_of reaches .685, above .765 and strictly_above .848.

blocks.en:
Before the first real-video result we fixed six rules that decide whether a setting passes; the main text reports the numbers behind them rather than the verdicts. C1 : gain ≥ .05 \geq.05 . C2 : INV-S ’s margin is positive and exceeds PRED ’s by more than 2 SE. C3 : INV-SHUF does not reproduce the gain, and INV-S beats it by more than 2 SE. C4 : the probe reads the relations at AUROC ≥ .75 \geq.75 in every arm; otherwise the run is uninformative, not negative. C5 : C1 – C3 hold on the compositional validation split. C6 : if the gain is within three seed SDs (pooled over PRED and INV-S ) of zero, seeds 3–4 are added and the five-seed verdict is final.
A setting passes only if all rules hold.
Each later experiment fixed its own rules, usually these, before its first result; experiments with tracked objects use the analogous rules L1–L4.
blocks.zh:
在第一个真实录像结果之前,我们制定了六项规则,决定设定是否通过;正文报告数字,而不是判决。 C1: 收益 .05\ geq.05。 C2:INV-S的比值是正的,超过PRED的比值超过2 SE. C3:INV-SHUF不复制增益,INV-S以2 SE以上击败. C4:探测器在每个臂上读取了AUROC \.75\geq.75中的关系;否则跑道是无成形的,不是负的. C5: C1 – C3 坚持组成验证分拆. C6:如果增收在3个种子SD(由PRED和INV-S联合而成)以0为单位,则会增加3–4个种子,而5个种子的判决是最终的.
只有在所有规则都有效时,才能通过设定。
每个后来的实验在第一次结果之前都确定了自己的规则,通常是这些规则;有轨物体的实验使用类似的规则L1-L4.

blocks.en:
The evaluator originally drew the random head behind C2 ’s margin (L2 for tracked objects) without a fixed seed, so a checkpoint’s margin varied between evaluations while its matched AUROC reproduced exactly; across nine further seeds, a single draw moves a checkpoint’s margin by up to about .13.
We therefore re-scored all 812 real-video checkpoints trained up to that point with the random head seeded at 0, using one evaluator.
Every matched AUROC reproduces (largest difference 2.7 × 10 − 5 2.7{\times}10^{-5} ) and no overall verdict changes.
Seeding roughly halves the 2 SE of margin-gain comparisons.
This turns C2 from fail to pass in the three-seed comparisons of the two V-JEPA 2 runs with video input (at five seeds it held either way, and C1 fails in both) and from pass to fail in the three-seed comparison with action labels on 5% of the pairs (already negative on C1 ), turns one descriptive margin comparison with tracked objects from fail to pass, and changes the verdict on INV-R in two five-relation settings from no grounding to partial grounding, because its small margin gain over PRED (about +.02) now clears 2 SE.
All margins in this paper use the seeded random head unless stated otherwise; two tracker evaluations could not be re-scored because their track alignments were not stored, and later experiments used the seeded evaluator from the start.
Each margin rests on one random head (seed 0); averaged over nine further seeds, every experiment’s mean margin lies within .025 of its seed-0 value.
